title: Drop zone
description: The compact FileDrop for a workspace panel: a light dashed tile on the panel surface with a title and a hint, the same checks (accept, maxSize, duplicates), keyboard and announcements; the file rows are optional.
when: Attachments in a WorkspaceSection (specs, sample photos), where the section label carries the count.
A narrow side panel that takes files.

instead.need: A form field or an import page with a row and progress per file
An image to crop or a single avatar
instead.use: an image picker of the app

a11y: A button (Enter / Space opens the file picker) named by aria-label, the surrounding Field or its title; the hidden input carries the same name for tests.
Added and rejected files are announced in a polite live region, as in FileDrop.
